rows.text: with c = `rcx`, m = qword `+8` of c and p = qword `+0x20` of c and N(x) = `00861F14` of x's squared length, for i below signed word `+0x14` of c it reads id = word [signed word `+0x12` + i] of the array at qword `+0x28` of m, skipping ids from `0x5000`; a gate on dword x skips when bit 31 is set after the mask/value pair at `0209A2D0` + `0x110` + 8k (k = 32 + bits 13-17 of x) is merged into x; an id from `0x4000` takes the `0x90`-byte element e = id - `0x4000` of qword `+0x18` of m, gates its dword `+4`, fills v by `00381D90(e, &v, p)`, skips unless L = N(v through the 3x3 at qword `+0x18` of c) exceeds r = `003810B0(e, p)`, and scales v by d = L - r; a lower id takes the 32-byte element e of qword `+0x10` of m, gates its dword `+0xC` only when its low 3 bits are 1, sets v to its four floats and L likewise, and needs s = (p minus vertex [signed word e`+0x10`] of qword `+8` of m) dot v in (-0.001, L), `0022EAC0(m, id, p, &w)` non-zero and q = N(w) below L, taking v = w, s = q when q exceeds s; v is scaled by d = L - s over N(v); then a d above float `+0x30` of c is stored there with id at word `+0x34`, and v is added to the three floats at qword `+0x28` of c

calls `00233110` with `rcx` and `rdx` unchanged and then `0022EF20(rdx)`; stores 0 in dword `020891E0` and, when the signed word `+0x52` of `rdx` is not negative, stores it in dword `02088FE0` and 1 in `020891E0`; stores 0 in dword `020891E4`, calls `0022F9B0(rcx, rdx, rdx)` and tail-jumps to `0022F250(rdx)`

builds A = `00202B70(&A, rdx+0x50, r8)` and B = `00202B70(&B, rdx+0x50, r9)` and on dword `+0` of `rdx` calls `00381AC0` for 0, `00381630` for 1 or `00381450` for 2, each as (&C, &A, &B); for any other kind or a zero result it returns -1.0 (`01CEBC9C`); otherwise it writes `00202B70(rcx, rdx+0x10, &C)` and returns `00861F14` of the squared distance between the first three floats at `rcx` and at `r8`

skipped.why: 1,168-byte body with about seven exits: two projection arms (y of rdx above 1.0 with y of r8 below 1.0, and y of rdx below -1.0 with y of r8 above -1.0, each through 0046BFA0 with the constant at 00D11280 or 00D11290 and a radius test), a fallback through 0046BF60 (00D11270), 00382020 on both inputs, 00861F56 and 00861F0E, and a final y range check that re-enters the store path; every path cannot be stated reliably in one sentence under the 1,200-character limit, so it is left for a direct read

notes: 0022DE60 (doubt: long row, near the 1,200-character limit): the gate reads (NOT m AND x) OR (v AND m) and skips when the result is at least 0x80000000 unsigned; the table pairs are 8 bytes apart starting at 0209A2D0+0x110/+0x114 with k = ((x >> 13) AND 0x1F) + 0x20. The 3x3 rows used are floats +0/+4/+8, +0x10/+0x14/+0x18, +0x20/+0x24/+0x28 of the matrix at qword +0x18. In the 0x4000 arm v is scaled by d only (no normalisation); in the lower arm v is multiplied by d and by 1.0 (01CEBBA8) divided by 00861F14 of its squared length. The trailing copy of dword +0xC of the qword +0x28 target onto itself (0022E2B8/0022E2BB) is a no-op and is not stated. The stack cookie (01F44830, 00808C40) is not stated in any row. 00232760: 00233110's argument count is not visible; the row says only that rcx and rdx reach it unchanged. 00380FA0: 00202B70's third argument is r8 for A (r8 is still the incoming value at 00380FCF) and r9 for B.
